note: Owner-directed macro region authoring (2026-08-23). Polygons are rasterized and override only the listed source classes, so wetlands/rivers keep their hydrological classes inside the shape.

overrides.name: tropical jungle
overrides.notes: Dense tropical jungle between the Archon-Gideon trunk (north), the Blackrose-Helstrom road (west) and Archon's hinterland (east). Owner decision; canon-compatible: dense vegetation thickening toward the interior (Tribes of Murkmire: Dead-Water), Murkwood's forest lore nearby to the south.
overrides.note: Owner-authored central tropical jungle. appliesToClasses gained the marsh classes on 2026-08-30: the saturated-ground rebalance (decision 0036 Q4) turned much of this polygon's interior from firm lowland into swamp, which would have shrunk the authored jungle by nearly half. A tropical rainforest standing on saturated ground is what this polygon always meant.
